name: Parks and Recreation Board - Jun 11, 2026
agenda_text:
PARKS AND RECREATION BOARD
City Council Chambers
275 E. Olive Ave.
Burbank, California 91502
JUNE 11, 2026
06:00 P.M.
This agenda contains a summary of each item of business which the Committee may discuss or act on at this meeting. The agenda packet consisting of the staff reports and all other documentation relating to each item on this agenda are on file in the office of the Parks and Recreation Department located at 150 N. Third St., and will be posted on the City's website at www.burbankusa.com. Any writings or documents provided to the Committee regarding any item on this agenda subsequent to distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection in the office of Parks and Recreation Department located at 150 N. Third St., during normal business hours. If you have a question about any matter on the agenda, please call the office of the Parks and Recreation Department at (818) 238-5300. The facility is disabled accessible. Auxiliary aids and services are available for individuals with speech, vision, or hearing impairments (48-hour notice is required). Please contact the ADA Coordinator at (818) 238-5424 voice or (818) 238-5035 TDD with questions or concerns.
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Regular Parks and Recreation Board Meeting will be held on Thursday, June 11, 2026, at 06:00 P.M. in the City Hall Council Chambers – 275 East Olive Avenue. Support documents of items on this Agenda may be obtained from the Parks, Recreation and Community Services Department or by visiting the City’s website at www.burbankca.gov .
Members of the public will have a total of three minutes to speak and have the option to participate in the meeting via in-person and/or telephone for General Public Comment. They may also submit their written comments regarding the business of the Parks and Recreation Board using the eComment feature on the City website.
Auxiliary aids and services are available for individuals with speech, vision, or hearing impairments (48-hour notice is required). For more information, please contact the ADA Coordinator at (818) 238-5051.
How to View the Meeting: Local Cable: Spectrum Channel 6 or AT&T Uverse Channel 99. YouTube Live Streaming Channel: Click here. City Website Live Streaming: Click here.
Public Comment Options: 1. To speak during Public Comment during the meeting, members of the public may speak in-person in the Council Chamber or call (818) 238-3335. Calls received will be placed in a queue and forwarded to the Chair in real time after in-person comments have been received. 2. eComment will remain open until 4:00 p.m. the night of the meeting. Any correspondence received after this time will be distributed the following business day.
